title: Self-work context switches wait for in-flight OpenAI-compatible proxy requests
body: Self-work and profile switches should not restart llama-server while an OpenAI-compatible /v1 chat completion proxy request is still in flight. Count proxied requests as active turns and delay context switches until they finish.
interface: proxyChatCompletion participates in the same in-turn accounting used by self-work/profile context switches.
why: A self-work run can otherwise unload the model out from under a normal chat/proxy request.
